tagline: A well-planned European side coastal district with marinas, a seaside promenade, shopping, and easy airport access.

items.name: Galleria AVM Cafés
items.description: Multiple café options inside the Galleria shopping centre on the seafront. Reliable and convenient.

items.name: Sahil Cafés
items.description: Waterfront cafés along the Ataköy marina with Sea of Marmara views. Good for a relaxed afternoon.

items.name: Ataköy Marina Restoranları
items.description: Restaurants around the Ataköy marina with sea views. A pleasant waterfront dining option on the European side.

items.name: Ataköy Marina
items.description: One of Istanbul's main marinas with yachts, restaurants, and a pleasant waterfront to walk.

items.name: Sahil Promenadı
items.description: A long coastal walkway connecting Ataköy to neighbouring Bakırköy. Good for cycling or evening walks with sea views.

tips: Ataköy is on the M1A metro line — direct to the airport and well connected to the city centre.
Primarily residential and practical rather than a destination in itself. The marina is the main draw.
Adjacent to Bakırköy, which has a better café and restaurant scene.
Good base if you need easy airport access while staying near the sea.
